{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing any non-numeric characters
# Replace any non-numeric characters (like commas or currency symbols) if present
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(r'[^\d.]+', '', regex=True).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute the mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = df_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Print the result
mean_revenue"}
